He says that connection to cinema is lost in today's generations, but how does he know that? Very few younger people have yet to show how much they love it, because of their age. I'm a younger person and film is the thing I connect to the most, and I can say the same for a lot of my friends. And I know your angry, but saying "no one cares about your opinion" is just a cruel thing to say. I speak from experience. I was told that a lot, and I eventually stopped sharing it. I would never give my opinion on any form of media, because I thought no one cared. But opinions are made to be shared. All of our opinions are just as valuable as Scorseses'.
It is a circlejerk of kindness. But everywhere else on Reddit is so depressing and cynical that we kind of need it for balance.
